description: A PHP class for generating an admin report in Revive Adserver that provides a breakdown of delivery metrics (impressions, clicks, conversions) grouped by agency, including methods for report initialization, default settings, execution, and data fetching.

classes.name: Plugins_Reports_OxReportsAdmin_Breakdown
classes.description: A plugin class for generating an admin agency breakdown report in Revive Adserver.

methods.name: initInfo
methods.description: Initializes report metadata such as name, description, category, author, export type, and authorization level.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Prepares default report parameters based on user session preferences.

methods.name: saveDefaults
methods.description: Saves user-selected report parameters into session preferences.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the report generation process, creating and sending the report file.

methods.name: _getReportParametersForDisplay
methods.description: Returns displayable report parameters, such as date range.

methods.name: _addAgencyBreakdownWorksheet
methods.description: Creates and adds the agency breakdown worksheet to the report.

methods.name: _fetchData
methods.description: Fetches agency delivery data from the database for the report.
